description: Koiari sit-in occurrence, location and government payment demand are supported, but no same-site participant count or evidence of 50 simultaneous people appears in the opened sources.
required_followup: A permitted contemporaneous report or original organizer/state record giving attendance at Rouna Two on July 21; do not infer from landowner group membership or city-wide service impact.

description: The July 23 water interruption is reported restored, but the end of the sit-in itself is not established.
required_followup: Permitted later reporting on the actual sit-in at Rouna Two; keep end date unknown unless it describes cessation.

description: Mulitaka residents’ election-rights gathering and demands are reported, but attendance at either site is not counted.
required_followup: A permitted event-specific source reporting simultaneous turnout at Mulitaka Secondary School or Andan Bridge.

description: Mulitaka report does not identify who damaged bridges or give an exact first date for the gathering; bridge damage cannot be attributed to demonstrators from proximity.
required_followup: A permitted contemporaneous report clarifying gathering date and who damaged infrastructure; maintain separate electoral-supporter violence and citizen-demonstration claims.

description: Open-web searches covered English and Tok Pisin/Hiri Motu terms and several local publishers across Central, Enga and Madang, but no systematic newspaper archive equivalent to LexisNexis or community-radio transcript corpus was used.
required_followup: If a specific source is needed for threshold, onset or attribution, check an accessible local/regional report or original record; no exhaustive census is claimed.
